2: Registered standing target and real pistol aim
5: Held F purchases relocated Mystery Box
7: Held F collects carbine into second slot
8: Original pistol selection and accepted injury
10: Nine-second pistol processing while remaining in reach
11: Automatic exact-slot Last Word return without F
15: Carbine processing while away; normal health recovery
17: Permanent carbine loss and closed receipt; pistol retained

measurement_limits: No perceptual audition is performed by this script.
Sample peaks are not oversampled true peaks, LUFS, or a guarantee against intersample clipping.
Full-scale sample counts use signed PCM endpoint values; near-full-scale counts use -0.1 dBFS.
Silence uses the maximum absolute channel sample per frame at the configured threshold; exact-zero counts are separate.
Energy events group RMS-threshold windows with the configured merge gap; they are not verified shot or animation event counts.
Phase labels are supplied capture annotations; no automatic identification of weapon type or event synchrony is claimed.
Null dBFS means exactly zero measured amplitude, mathematically negative infinity.
quiet_window_limit: These merged windows remain entirely at or below -60 dBFS sample peak. Silence, including pause/death phases, is measured without an automatic audible-phase pass requirement.
